changelog: Plan your week in one tap: Build recurring routines (like a Morning or Workout ritual) and apply them across your calendar in seconds.
New calendar view: Tap to open the full month calendar and easily plan ahead for any day.
Brand-new look: Fresh app icon on your home screen and a playful animated mascot that greets you when you open the app.
Faster, lighter download: Cut the download size down by 65% so the app installs almost instantly.
